title: lycianthes radiata
intro: Lycianthes radiata, commonly known as the Night-Blooming Lycianthes or Purple Queen, is a flowering plant species in the Solanaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to help reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, likely due to its therapeutic actions as an antioxidant and vasodilator. The bioactive constituents of Lycianthes radiata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the potential benefits and actions of this plant.
